question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Unique
solution:
The correct answer is **Exclusive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exclusive **means unique or one-of-a-kind, which is the same as the given word 'unique'. (अनोखा या एक तरह का)
 
• It is an adjective that describes something that is not common or typical.
 
 
• **Example**: *The designer created an exclusive dress for the celebrity to wear at the red carpet event.*
 
 

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **General **means common or widespread. (सामान्य या व्यापक)
 
• **Ordinary **means normal or average. (सामान्य या औसत)
 
• **Usual **means typical or customary. (विशिष्ट या प्रथागत)
